# Search page layout

Generated by the CRE Cloud Solutions plugin (`tools/search-layout/build-search-reference.php`) from its own registry. Do not edit by hand: regenerate. The machine-readable form, which `scripts/crecs_search.py` reads, is `search-layout.json` beside this file.

The property search page (the site's search slug, usually `/properties`) is not an Elementor page. The plugin draws it from a **layout document**: a tree of the page's blocks in Elementor's shape, which says where each block goes, how it looks and what its texts say. The blocks themselves (the filters, the map, the results) are the plugin's own markup; a document arranges, restyles and retexts them, and can never rewrite them.

## The document

```json
{"type": "crecs-search-layout", "version": 1, "title": "…", "content": [ <one crecs_search_page block> ]}
```

Every block is `{"id", "elType", "widgetType", "settings", "elements"}`. `id` is 4 to 16 letters or digits, unique in the document. `elType` is `container` for blocks that hold others and `widget` for the rest. `widgetType` names the block, for containers too. `settings` holds only the controls listed below for that block; `elements` is the list of blocks inside.

## What the plugin refuses

The preview and Publish refuse a document with any of these, and the live page falls back to the built-in layout rather than render one.

| code | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `E-SL-SHAPE` | not a search layout document (`type`, `version` 1, `content`) |
| `E-SL-ROOT` | `content` must be exactly one `crecs_search_page` block, and the page block can only be the root |
| `E-SL-NODE` | a block lacks `id`, `elType`, `widgetType`, `settings` or `elements` |
| `E-SL-ID` | an id that is not 4 to 16 letters or digits, or that two blocks share |
| `E-SL-BLOCK` | a `widgetType` the plugin does not have |
| `E-SL-ELTYPE` | a block given the wrong `elType` |
| `E-SL-CHILDREN` | a widget holding other blocks |
| `E-SL-REQUIRED` | a block the page needs is missing: every block but the error notice and the box is required |
| `E-SL-ONCE` | a block that carries ids the scripts look up appears twice; only the box repeats |
| `E-SL-WITHIN` | a filter outside the filters block: Clear resets and walks the filters form |
| `E-SL-NOT-WITHIN` | anything but a filter or a box inside the filters block: Clear would reset it |
| `E-SL-SETTING` | a setting the block does not have |
| `E-SL-VALUE` | a value outside what its control accepts, or settings of one block that do not fit together (see *What the page starts with*) |
| `E-SL-STUCK` | a filter starts with a value and cannot be seen on a device (it, its choice or a box around it is hidden there) where Clear cannot be seen either: visitors there could never remove it |
| `E-SL-LIMIT` | more than 150 blocks, or nested more than 12 deep |

## Control names

- `{target}_{property}`: the style of a named part of a block. Add `_hover` for the hover state (only `color`, `background_color` and `border_color`, and only on targets marked *hover*). Add `_tablet` or `_mobile` for a device, when the property is responsive.
- `_margin`, `_padding`, `_width`, `_grow`, `_order`, each with `_tablet` and `_mobile`: the block's own box, on every block but the page. `_grow: "yes"` takes the room left; `_order` reorders it among its siblings.
- `direction`, `wrap`, `gap`, `justify`, `align`, each with `_tablet` and `_mobile`: how a container lays out its blocks (a flex row or column). Only on containers marked *lays out*.
- `map_height`, `map_height_tablet`, `map_height_mobile`: the map's height.
- `_hide_desktop`, `_hide_tablet`, `_hide_mobile`: `"yes"` hides a block on that device, and on that device only. A hidden filter, map or button only stops showing: its markup stays, because the page's scripts read it, and a hidden filter still searches with whatever value it starts with. The blocks that have them: Map (`crecs_search_map`, tablet and mobile only), Keyword search (`crecs_search_filter_keyword`), For Sale / For Lease (`crecs_search_filter_category`), Property type filter (`crecs_search_filter_property_type`), Size filter (`crecs_search_filter_size`), Rate/price filter (`crecs_search_filter_rate`), Broker filter (`crecs_search_filter_broker`), Clear button (`crecs_search_filter_clear`), View buttons (`crecs_search_view_options`, desktop only), Box (`crecs_search_box`).
- `text_{slot}`: an editable text, printed as plain text. Empty means the page's own text.
- `start_*` and `offer`: what the page starts with rather than how it looks (*What the page starts with*, below). They print no CSS.

A device inherits from the larger one unless it sets its own value: desktop first, then tablet (up to 1023px), then mobile (up to 599px). An empty value means "leave the page as it is".

| `border_color` | box | a colour: `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()`, `rgba()` or `transparent` | desktop value applies to all |
| `border_radius` | box | `{"unit": u, "top": n, "right": n, "bottom": n, "left": n}`, u one of `px`, `%`, each n from 0 to 200 | desktop value applies to all |
| `box_shadow` | box | `{"horizontal": -50..50, "vertical": -50..50, "blur": 0..100, "spread": -50..50, "color": a colour}`, in pixels | desktop value applies to all |
| `padding` | box | `{"unit": u, "top": n, "right": n, "bottom": n, "left": n}`, u one of `px`, `em`, `%`, each n from 0 to 200 | all three |
| `color` | text, icon | a colour: `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()`, `rgba()` or `transparent` | desktop value applies to all |

| `font_weight` | text | one of `300`, `400`, `500`, `600`, `700`, `800`, `normal`, `bold` | desktop value applies to all |
| `line_height` | text | `{"unit": u, "size": n}`, u one of `""` (no unit), `px`, `em`, n from 0 to 200 (at most 100 in % or vh) | all three |
| `letter_spacing` | text | `{"unit": u, "size": n}`, u one of `px`, `em`, n from -5 to 20 (at most 100 in % or vh) | desktop value applies to all |
| `text_transform` | text | one of `none`, `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `capitalize` | desktop value applies to all |
| `font_style` | text | one of `normal`, `italic` | desktop value applies to all |
| `text_align` | text | one of `left`, `center`, `right` | all three |
| `order` | item | a whole number from -20 to 20 | desktop value applies to all |
| `hide` | item, toggle | `"yes"`, or empty | desktop value applies to all |

### Box, layout and map

| control | value |
| --- | --- |
| `_margin` | `{"unit": u, "top": n, "right": n, "bottom": n, "left": n}`, u one of `px`, `em`, `%`, each n from -200 to 200 |
| `_padding` | `{"unit": u, "top": n, "right": n, "bottom": n, "left": n}`, u one of `px`, `em`, `%`, each n from 0 to 200 |
| `_width` | `{"unit": u, "size": n}`, u one of `px`, `%`, n from 0 to 2000 (at most 100 in % or vh) |
| `_grow` | `"yes"`, or empty |
| `_order` | a whole number from -20 to 20 |
| `direction` | one of `row`, `column` |
| `wrap` | one of `wrap`, `nowrap` |
| `gap` | `{"unit": u, "size": n}`, u one of `px`, n from 0 to 200 (at most 100 in % or vh) |
| `justify` | one of `flex-start`, `center`, `flex-end`, `space-between`, `space-around` |
| `align` | one of `stretch`, `flex-start`, `center`, `flex-end` |
| `map_height` | `{"unit": u, "size": n}`, u one of `px`, `vh`, n from 100 to 2000 (at most 100 in % or vh) |

Fonts: `Roboto`, `Arial`, `Helvetica`, `Verdana`, `Calibri`, `Comic Sans`, `Times New Roman`, `Times`, `Cambria`, `Courier New`, `Courier`. Nothing else is loaded, so no other font can be used.

## What the page starts with

These settings change what a visitor first sees, not how it looks. Each block lists its own under *Options*.

- **Starting values.** The keyword (`start_text`), For Sale and For Lease (`start_for_sale`, `start_for_lease`), the property types and brokers checked (`start_checked`), the size unit (`start_unit`; square feet unless set) and the size and rate ranges (`start_min`, `start_max`). The first search already applies them, and they show in their filters: they are defaults, not fixed restrictions. A visitor can change or remove each one, or all at once with Clear, which clears every filter, starting values included (the size unit stays as chosen). Tell the person so whenever they ask for one. An address that already names a category, a property type or a broker (an SEO page such as `/properties/office--properties`) wins over the matching starting value; the keyword, size and rate ones apply on every address.
- **Shorter lists.** `offer` on the property type and broker filters: the names the list shows, in that order. They are the site's own names, which the preview lists, matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces; a name the site does not list today shows nothing. With nothing checked, the search then covers only the offered names instead of all of them. Unset, the list shows every name the site lists, in the site's order. The API matches a type as a phrase, so offering `Office` also finds `Medical Office` listings.
- **The starting view.** `start_view` on the results (list or grid), `start_sort` on the sort, `start_map` on the map (computers only, where the map's own button shows and hides it). Unset, the view and the map follow the plugin's settings screen.
- **Hiding.** A filter, Clear, the map (on tablets and phones, which have no map button) and the view buttons (on computers, the only devices that show them) hide per device with `_hide_*`. One choice of a filter hides with `for_sale_option_hide`, `for_lease_option_hide`, `square_feet_option_hide` or `acres_option_hide`, on every device; one view button with `map_button_hide`, `list_button_hide` or `grid_button_hide`, and `map_button_order`, `list_button_order`, `grid_button_order` reorder them.

The plugin refuses, as `E-SL-VALUE`, a `start_checked` name that `offer` does not list, a `start_min` larger than `start_max`, both choices of a filter hidden (hide the block instead) and a size that starts in a hidden unit; and, as `E-SL-STUCK`, a starting value that cannot be seen on a device where Clear cannot be seen either (hidden itself, by its hidden choice or by a hidden box around it), because visitors there could never remove it.

## The cards and the map popup

The result cards and the popup a pin opens are set on the **Results** block (`crecs_search_results`) and the **Map** block (`crecs_search_map`).

- **The card's lines.** `card_fields` lists the card's text lines in the order they show, from `name`, `address`, `sub_type`, `available_sf`, `available_acres`, `land_sf`, `min_sf`, `max_sf`, `rates`, `buttons`. A line not in the list is not shown; a line whose value a property lacks shows nothing for that property, as today. The photo, the type badge on it, the highlight banner and the **Map It** button hide with `photo_hide`, `badge_hide`, `banner_hide` and `map_button_hide`.
- **The card's words.** `text_sub_type`, `text_available_sf`, `text_available_acres`, `text_land_sf`, `text_min_sf`, `text_max_sf` are the labels before the values; `text_view_button` and `text_map_button` the two buttons.
- **The photo** keeps one proportion with `photo_ratio` (width:height), in the list and in the grid, and the photos fill it.
- **The grid's columns** are set per device, and **none inherits** from another: `grid_columns` on computers while the map shows, `grid_columns_without_map` on computers while it is hidden, `grid_columns_tablet`, `grid_columns_mobile`. An unset one keeps the page's own: two (three on very wide screens) with the map, five without it, one on tablets and phones. `per_page` is how many results a page shows.
- **The popup.** Until `popup_fields` is set, a pin opens the popup CRE Cloud sends, which the layout cannot change except its width (`popup_width`). Once it is set, the plugin builds the popup from the same data as the card: the photo, with the category over it, on the left, the other parts on the right in the list's order, from `photo`, `category`, `name`, `address`, `property_type`, `sub_type`, `available_sf`, `available_acres`, `land_sf`, `min_sf`, `max_sf`, `rates`, `view_button`. The size lines take the card's labels; the button's text is `text_popup_button`; the `popup`, `popup_name`, `popup_details`, `popup_category` and `popup_button` parts take colours, fonts and the rest like any other part.

## The map itself

Set on the **Map** block (`crecs_search_map`); the map reads them when it opens, and each beats the plugin's settings screen. Unset, the map opens as it does today: the settings screen's zoom and centre (or the first property found when it has no centre), streets, the site's own grey look, and Google's controls on computers but none on phones.

- **Where it opens.** `map_zoom`, and the limits visitors can zoom between, `map_min_zoom` and `map_max_zoom` (the zoom must sit between them). `map_center_lat` and `map_center_lng` go together and make the map open on that place, on every search address.
- **How it behaves.** `map_type` (streets, satellite, both, relief) and `map_gestures`. The controls — `map_zoom_control`, `map_type_control`, `map_fullscreen_control`, `map_street_view_control` — are `shown` or `hidden`, and once set they apply on phones too, which show none today.
- **How it looks.** `map_style` picks a ready-made look (`site`, `google`, `silver`, `dark`, `retro`); `map_water_color`, `map_land_color`, `map_road_color` and `map_label_color` go over it, written `#rrggbb`, and `map_labels` and `map_points_of_interest` show or hide those.

### Map — `crecs_search_map`

Widget, required, can be hidden.

Parts you can style:

- `frame` (box): `frame_background_color`, `frame_border_style`, `frame_border_width`, `frame_border_color`, `frame_border_radius`, `frame_box_shadow`, `frame_padding`
- `popup` (box, text): `popup_background_color`, `popup_border_style`, `popup_border_width`, `popup_border_color`, `popup_border_radius`, `popup_box_shadow`, `popup_padding`, `popup_color`, `popup_font_family`, `popup_font_size`, `popup_font_weight`, `popup_line_height`, `popup_letter_spacing`, `popup_text_transform`, `popup_font_style`, `popup_text_align`
- `popup_name` (text): `popup_name_color`, `popup_name_font_family`, `popup_name_font_size`, `popup_name_font_weight`, `popup_name_line_height`, `popup_name_letter_spacing`, `popup_name_text_transform`, `popup_name_font_style`, `popup_name_text_align`
- `popup_details` (text): `popup_details_color`, `popup_details_font_family`, `popup_details_font_size`, `popup_details_font_weight`, `popup_details_line_height`, `popup_details_letter_spacing`, `popup_details_text_transform`, `popup_details_font_style`, `popup_details_text_align`
- `popup_category` (box, text): `popup_category_background_color`, `popup_category_border_style`, `popup_category_border_width`, `popup_category_border_color`, `popup_category_border_radius`, `popup_category_box_shadow`, `popup_category_padding`, `popup_category_color`, `popup_category_font_family`, `popup_category_font_size`, `popup_category_font_weight`, `popup_category_line_height`, `popup_category_letter_spacing`, `popup_category_text_transform`, `popup_category_font_style`, `popup_category_text_align`
- `popup_button` (box, text, hover): `popup_button_background_color`, `popup_button_border_style`, `popup_button_border_width`, `popup_button_border_color`, `popup_button_border_radius`, `popup_button_box_shadow`, `popup_button_padding`, `popup_button_color`, `popup_button_font_family`, `popup_button_font_size`, `popup_button_font_weight`, `popup_button_line_height`, `popup_button_letter_spacing`, `popup_button_text_transform`, `popup_button_font_style`, `popup_button_text_align`

Texts:

- `text_popup_button`: "View Listing"

Options:

- `start_map`: how the map starts on computers; unset, the settings screen decides. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.
- `popup_fields`: what the popup a pin opens shows, built by the plugin from the card's data: the photo, with the category over it, on the left, the other parts on the right in this order; unset, the popup CRE Cloud sends. Value: a list of parts, each once, in the order they show, from `photo`, `category`, `name`, `address`, `property_type`, `sub_type`, `available_sf`, `available_acres`, `land_sf`, `min_sf`, `max_sf`, `rates`, `view_button`.
- `popup_width`: the popup's width in pixels; unset, 370. Value: a whole number from 220 to 600.
- `map_zoom`: the zoom the map opens with, 1 (the world) to 20 (a building); unset, the settings screen decides. Value: a whole number from 1 to 20.
- `map_min_zoom`: how far out visitors can zoom; unset, no limit. Value: a whole number from 1 to 20.
- `map_max_zoom`: how far in visitors can zoom; unset, no limit. Value: a whole number from 1 to 20.
- `map_center_lat`: the latitude the map opens on, with `map_center_lng`; unset, the settings screen's centre, or the first property found when it has none. Value: a number from -90 to 90, decimals allowed, written as a number.
- `map_center_lng`: the longitude the map opens on, with `map_center_lat`. Value: a number from -180 to 180, decimals allowed, written as a number.
- `map_type`: the map's type: streets, satellite, satellite with names, or relief; unset, streets. Value: one of `roadmap`, `satellite`, `hybrid`, `terrain`.
- `map_gestures`: how the map answers scrolling and dragging: `cooperative` needs Ctrl (two fingers on phones), `greedy` always moves, `none` never; unset, `auto`. Value: one of `auto`, `cooperative`, `greedy`, `none`.
- `map_zoom_control`: the + and - buttons. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.
- `map_type_control`: the map / satellite switch. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.
- `map_fullscreen_control`: the full-screen button. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.
- `map_street_view_control`: the Street View figure. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.
- `map_style`: a ready-made look: the site's own, Google's standard one, silver, dark or retro; unset, the site's own. Value: one of `site`, `google`, `silver`, `dark`, `retro`.
- `map_water_color`: the water's colour, over the look. Value: a colour written `#rrggbb` or `#rgb` (the map takes nothing else).
- `map_land_color`: the land's colour, over the look. Value: a colour written `#rrggbb` or `#rgb` (the map takes nothing else).
- `map_road_color`: the roads' colour, over the look. Value: a colour written `#rrggbb` or `#rgb` (the map takes nothing else).
- `map_label_color`: the colour of the map's names and labels, over the look. Value: a colour written `#rrggbb` or `#rgb` (the map takes nothing else).
- `map_labels`: the map's names and labels, all of them. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.
- `map_points_of_interest`: shops, schools, parks and other places of interest; the site's own look hides them. Value: one of `shown`, `hidden`.

- `text_sub_type`: "Type"
- `text_available_sf`: "Available SF"
- `text_available_acres`: "Available AC"
- `text_land_sf`: "Land SF"
- `text_min_sf`: "Min Available SF"

- `text_view_button`: "View"
- `text_map_button`: "Map It"

Options:

- `start_view`: how the results start; unset, the settings screen decides. Value: one of `list`, `grid`.
- `card_fields`: the card's text lines, in this order; a line not named is not shown; unset, all of them as the page has them. Value: a list of parts, each once, in the order they show, from `name`, `address`, `sub_type`, `available_sf`, `available_acres`, `land_sf`, `min_sf`, `max_sf`, `rates`, `buttons`.
- `photo_ratio`: the card photo's proportion, width to height; unset, as the page has it. Value: one of `4:3`, `3:2`, `16:9`, `1:1`.
- `grid_columns`: cards per row in the grid on computers while the map shows; unset, the page's own (2, or 3 on very wide screens). Value: a whole number from 1 to 6.
- `grid_columns_tablet`: cards per row in the grid on tablets; unset, 1. Value: a whole number from 1 to 4.
- `grid_columns_mobile`: cards per row in the grid on phones; unset, 1. Value: a whole number from 1 to 2.
- `grid_columns_without_map`: cards per row in the grid on computers while the map is hidden; unset, the page's own (5). Value: a whole number from 1 to 8.
- `per_page`: how many results a page shows; unset, the settings screen decides. Value: a whole number from 1 to 100.

## The built-in layout

What a site shows until someone publishes a layout, and where a first preview starts:

- `5e2a0001` Page (`crecs_search_page`)
  - `5e2a0002` Main area (`crecs_search_wrapper`)
    - `5e2a0003` Error notice (kept hidden) (`crecs_search_notice`)
    - `5e2a0004` Map (`crecs_search_map`)
    - `5e2a0005` Filters (`crecs_search_filters`)
      - `5e2a0006` Keyword search (`crecs_search_filter_keyword`)
      - `5e2a0007` For Sale / For Lease (`crecs_search_filter_category`)
      - `5e2a0008` Property type filter (`crecs_search_filter_property_type`)
      - `5e2a0009` Size filter (`crecs_search_filter_size`)
      - `5e2a000a` Rate/price filter (`crecs_search_filter_rate`)
      - `5e2a000b` Broker filter (`crecs_search_filter_broker`)
      - `5e2a000c` Clear button (`crecs_search_filter_clear`)
    - `5e2a000d` Results area (`crecs_search_listings`)
      - `5e2a000e` Results heading (`crecs_search_results_heading`)
      - `5e2a000f` Sort (`crecs_search_sort`)
      - `5e2a0010` View buttons (`crecs_search_view_options`)
      - `5e2a0011` Results (`crecs_search_results`)
  - `5e2a0012` Discover-more links (`crecs_search_seo_links`)
